extraMeanings.en: to predict a future event or condition
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Economists forecast that inflation will fall next year.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ekonomistler enflasyonun gelecek yıl düşeceğini tahmin ediyor.

extraMeanings.en: to make something the most prominent or important element
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The report foregrounds the needs of low-income families.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Rapor, düşük gelirli ailelerin ihtiyaçlarını ön plana çıkarıyor.

extraMeanings.en: to break or crack, or to split apart
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He fractured his wrist while skiing.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kayak yaparken bileğini kırdı.

extraMeanings.en: a division or split within a group
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The scandal caused a deep fracture within the party.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Skandal, parti içinde derin bir bölünmeye yol açtı.

extraMeanings.en: an action against the rules in a sport
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The referee gave a free kick after the foul.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hakem, fauldan sonra serbest vuruş verdi.

extraMeanings.en: a raised ridge on the neck of a stringed instrument
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She pressed her finger down on the second fret.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Parmağını ikinci perdeye bastırdı.

extraMeanings.en: the resistance when one surface moves over another
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Oil reduces the friction between the moving parts.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yağ, hareketli parçalar arasındaki sürtünmeyi azaltır.

extraMeanings.en: the furthest limit of knowledge in a field
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Artificial intelligence is the new frontier of research.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yapay zeka, araştırmanın yeni sınırıdır.

extraMeanings.en: to make someone feel satisfied and happy
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Her job as a teacher truly fulfills her.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Öğretmenlik işi onu gerçekten tatmin ediyor.

extraMeanings.en: to retch or nearly vomit
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The awful smell made me gag.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Berbat koku beni öğürttü.

extraMeanings.en: to prevent someone from speaking or expressing opinions
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The government tried to gag the press.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hükümet basını susturmaya çalıştı.

extraMeanings.en: an instrument for measuring amount or level
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The fuel gauge showed that the tank was nearly empty.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yakıt göstergesi deponun neredeyse boş olduğunu gösteriyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to look steadily at something for a long time
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She gazed out of the window at the sea.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Pencereden denize uzun uzun baktı.

extraMeanings.en: to design or organize something for a particular purpose
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The course is geared toward beginners.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kurs, yeni başlayanlara göre uyarlanmıştır.

extraMeanings.en: lacking distinctive features; not specific
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The film has a generic plot that we've all seen before.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Filmin, hepimizin daha önce gördüğü sıradan bir konusu var.

extraMeanings.en: exceptional natural ability or brilliance
extraMeanings.exampleEn: It took real genius to solve that problem.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: O sorunu çözmek gerçek bir deha gerektirdi.

extraMeanings.en: to stare angrily at someone or something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She glared at him and left the room.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ona dik dik baktı ve odadan çıktı.

extraMeanings.en: to shine with a soft, steady light
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The polished floor gleamed in the sunlight.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Cilalı zemin güneş ışığında parıldıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to avoid dealing with something by treating it briefly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He glossed over the problems in his report.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Raporundaki sorunların üstünü geçiştirdi.

extraMeanings.en: to produce a steady light or a warm feeling
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Her cheeks glowed with excitement.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yanakları heyecandan parlıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: a thousand dollars or pounds
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The car cost me twenty grand.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Araba bana yirmi bin (dolar) mal oldu.

extraMeanings.en: the direction of fibres in wood or fabric
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Sand the wood along the grain, not across it.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ahşabı damarına ters değil, damar yönünde zımparalayın.

extraMeanings.en: a very small amount of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There isn't a grain of truth in what he said.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Söylediklerinde bir zerre gerçeklik yok.

extraMeanings.en: to understand something fully
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She quickly grasped the main idea of the lesson.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Dersin ana fikrini hemen kavradı.

extraMeanings.en: to hold something firmly with your hand
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He grasped the rope and pulled himself up.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İpi sıkıca kavradı ve kendini yukarı çekti.

extraMeanings.en: to hold something very tightly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She gripped the railing as the boat rocked.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Tekne sallanırken korkuluğu sıkıca tuttu.

extraMeanings.en: to hold someone's attention completely
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The movie gripped the audience from start to finish.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Film, izleyiciyi başından sonuna kadar esir aldı.

extraMeanings.en: to smile broadly showing your teeth
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He grinned when he heard the good news.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İyi haberi duyunca sırıttı.

extraMeanings.en: an enjoyable rhythm or a settled routine of doing something well
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Once the band found their groove, the crowd started dancing.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Grup ritmini bulunca kalabalık dans etmeye başladı.

extraMeanings.en: very unpleasant or disgusting
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There was a gross smell coming from the bin.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çöp kutusundan iğrenç bir koku geliyordu.

extraMeanings.en: the small solid pieces left at the bottom, especially of coffee
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She threw the coffee grounds into the compost.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kahve telvesini kompost yığınına attı.

extraMeanings.tr: putlaştırılan kişi/şey, çok önem verilen şey
extraMeanings.en: a person or thing that is greatly admired or worshipped
extraMeanings.exampleEn: For him, money became a god.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Onun için para bir tanrıya dönüştü.

extraMeanings.en: to eat a large amount greedily
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They gorged themselves on cake at the party.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Partide pastayla tıka basa doydular.
